# GenZee Video Studio — Full AI Context

> Comprehensive platform overview and architecture reference for AI search engines, agents, and Large Language Models.

## Platform Identity
- Name: GenZee Video Studio
- Domain: https://www.genzee.video
- Category: Multimedia Creative Studio / Creator OS
- Description: All-in-one AI voice synthesis and multi-platform content automation studio for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok creators.

## Supported Voice Synthesis Engines
1. ElevenLabs Neural Engine: Premium broadcast narration with high emotional range and lifelike pacing.
2. Google Gemini Voice: Fast, multi-lingual conversational synthesis ideal for dialogue and vertical shorts.
3. Fish Audio V2.0 Pro: High-fidelity speech synthesis with variable voice timber and acoustic flexibility.
4. Open Source TTS Engine: Fast, lightweight open-weights synthesis for zero-friction voice generation.

## Multi-Platform Publishing Workflows
- Facebook Feeds & Pages: Direct publishing, media attachments, and custom text captions.
- Instagram Reels: Vertical 9:16 short-form video previews and scheduled publishing.
- YouTube Strategy Engine: Complete campaign decomposition from high-level prompts into 1 long-form video essay and 3 vertical shorts.

## Content Ingestion
- Prompt-to-JSON Campaign Engine: Ingest structured JSON payloads generated by Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or DeepSeek into editable daily calendars.
- Zero Technical Jargon: Clean, creator-first user experience.
